# RRgeo <img src="inst/figures/RRgeo_logo.png" align="right" height="160"/>

<!-- badges: start -->

[![cranlogs](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/RRgeo)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=RRgeo)  [![total](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/RRgeo)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=RRgeo)

<!-- badges: end -->


`RRgeo` toolbox includes functions to perform SDMs for rare species and to find the area of origin and potential hybridization zones between species.

## Installation

You can install the development version of RRgeo like so:

``` r
devtools::install_github("pasraia/RRgeo")
```
